topic: Text-to-SQL Generation with Large Language Models: Schema Linking, Benchmarks, and Robustness

judge.rationale: Spider is a foundational benchmark for cross-domain text-to-SQL, directly relevant to the survey's focus on benchmarks and robustness in text-to-SQL generation with LLMs.
The paper introduces BIRD, a large-scale text-to-SQL benchmark that directly addresses schema linking, robustness, and real-world challenges, making it a core reference for the survey topic.

The paper directly addresses text-to-SQL generation using LLMs, focusing on decomposition and in-context learning to improve performance on the Spider benchmark, which aligns with the survey's core themes of schema linking, benchmarks, and robustness.
The paper directly addresses text-to-SQL generation with a focus on schema linking and robustness, which are core topics of the survey.
The paper presents a zero-shot Text-to-SQL method using a large language model (ChatGPT), directly addressing the survey's core focus on Text-to-SQL generation with LLMs.
